how: Curated PHP refactor commits named in the spec (sem-diff-languages.md section 5), read and labelled by hand on 2026-11-14 before any PHP engine code existed. The held-out composer commit is not labelled here; its claims go to the blind audit. Plus the 300-commit practice datasets (laravel/framework at da870df31b, symfony/symfony at 979969dc83): every loose candidate (51), labelled blind by two independent Fable agents following harness/LABELLING.md, before any PHP engine code existed.
